title: Gorodok
summary: Gorodok is a term that can refer to various locations and entities, particularly in [[eastern-europe|Eastern Europe]], including connections to Ukraine. It encompasses several inhabited localities, historical military operations, and cultural references.

sections.heading: Geographical References
paragraphs: Gorodok is associated with multiple inhabited localities in Russia, indicating its use as a place name in that country.
In the context of [[ukraine|Ukraine]], the term 'Horodok' refers to various [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] places that may be referred to as 'Gorodok' in Russian.

sections.heading: Cultural and Historical Significance
paragraphs: Gorodok Stadium is part of the Luzhniki Olympic Complex located in Moscow, Russia, highlighting its relevance in sports and cultural events.
The term also relates to the Gorodok offensive, a military operation conducted by the Red Army during World War II, which has historical implications for the region.

sections.heading: Media and Entertainment
paragraphs: Gorodok is also the title of a television programme, reflecting its cultural presence beyond geographical references.
